description_en: Adds or removes elastic network interfaces (ENIs) that participate in private network traffic diversion for a specified VPC. This operation is executed asynchronously and returns a task ID
description_zh: 为指定 VPC 增加或移除参与私网引流的弹性网卡。接口异步执行，返回任务 ID
name: UpdatePrivateTractionAssets

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC instance
parameters.name: vpc_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs of elastic network interface controller (NIC) to add to private network traffic diversion
parameters.help_zh: 要增加到私网引流中的弹性网卡实例 ID 列表
parameters.name: added_eni_instance_id_list

parameters.help_en: The list of instance IDs of elastic network interface controller (NIC) to remove from private network traffic diversion
parameters.help_zh: 要从私网引流中移除的弹性网卡实例 ID 列表
parameters.name: removed_eni_instance_id_list

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 目的地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: destination_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The destination port range in the format of start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required when the protocol is TCP or UDP
fields.help_zh: 目的端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: destination_port_range

fields.help_en: The priority of the sub-rule. Valid values: 1 to 16777216. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Priorities must be unique within the same direction
fields.help_zh: 子规则优先级，取值范围为 1～16777216。数字越小，优先级越高；同一方向内优先级不可重复
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The network protocol to match. Valid values: ALL (all protocols), ICMP, TCP, and UDP
fields.help_zh: 匹配的网络协议。ALL 表示全部协议，ICMP、TCP、UDP 表示对应协议
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The source CIDR block. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 源地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: source_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The source port range in the format of start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required when the protocol is TCP or UDP
fields.help_zh: 源端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: source_port_range

fields.help_en: The action to perform on matched traffic. A value of accept indicates that traffic is captured. A value of drop indicates that traffic is not captured
fields.help_zh: 匹配流量的处理动作。accept 表示采集，drop 表示不采集
fields.name: sub_rule_action

fields.help_en: The list of outbound filter sub-rules
fields.help_zh: 出方向过滤子规则列表
fields.name: egress_sub_rules

fields.help_en: The destination CIDR block. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 目的地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: destination_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The destination port range in the format of start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required when the protocol is TCP or UDP
fields.help_zh: 目的端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: destination_port_range

fields.help_en: The priority of the sub-rule. Valid values: 1 to 16777216. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Priorities must be unique within the same direction
fields.help_zh: 子规则优先级，取值范围为 1～16777216。数字越小，优先级越高；同一方向内优先级不可重复
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The network protocol to match. Valid values: ALL (all protocols), ICMP, TCP, and UDP
fields.help_zh: 匹配的网络协议。ALL 表示全部协议，ICMP、TCP、UDP 表示对应协议
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The source CIDR block. A value of 0.0.0.0/0 indicates all IPv4 addresses
fields.help_zh: 源地址网段，使用 CIDR 格式；0.0.0.0/0 表示全部 IPv4 地址
fields.name: source_cidr_block

fields.help_en: The source port range in the format of start port/end port, such as 80/443. A value of -1/-1 indicates all ports. This parameter is required when the protocol is TCP or UDP
fields.help_zh: 源端口范围，格式为 起始端口/结束端口，例如 80/443；-1/-1 表示全部端口。TCP 或 UDP 协议必填
fields.name: source_port_range

fields.help_en: The action to perform on matched traffic. A value of accept indicates that traffic is captured. A value of drop indicates that traffic is not captured
fields.help_zh: 匹配流量的处理动作。accept 表示采集，drop 表示不采集
fields.name: sub_rule_action

fields.help_en: The list of inbound filter sub-rules
fields.help_zh: 入方向过滤子规则列表
fields.name: ingress_sub_rules

fields.example: 采集指定网段的 TCP 流量
fields.help_en: The description of the filter rule. It must be less than 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 过滤规则描述。少于 256 个字符，不能以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
fields.name: rule_description

fields.help_en: The name of the filter rule. It must be less than 128 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://
fields.help_zh: 过滤规则名称。少于 128 个字符，不能以 http:// 或 https:// 开头
fields.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The filter rule snapshot used for creating a new traffic mirror session. If not specified, all traffic is captured. This parameter does not replace the filter rules of existing traffic mirror sessions
parameters.help_zh: 新建镜像会话使用的过滤规则快照。不传时采集全部流量；不会替换已有镜像会话的过滤规则
parameters.name: filter_rule

fields.help_en: Filters assets by the cloud service type using lowercase identifiers. Valid values: ecs, eci, and acs
fields.help_zh: 按资产所属云服务类型筛选，使用小写标识。支持引流的类型包括 `ecs`、`eci`、`acs`
fields.name: cloud_type

fields.help_en: The list of asset instance IDs. An asset matches if its instance ID matches any value in the list
fields.help_zh: 资产实例 ID 列表。资产实例 ID 命中列表中任一值即可
fields.name: instance_id_list

fields.help_en: Performs a fuzzy match based on the asset instance name. You can specify the full name or a part of the name
fields.help_zh: 按资产实例名称模糊匹配，可传入完整名称或名称中的一段
fields.name: instance_name

fields.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the target VPC belongs. If omitted, the account to which the target VPC belongs is used. If specified, it must be the same as the account
fields.help_zh: 目标 VPC 所属阿里云账号 ID。省略时使用目标 VPC 所属账号。传入时须与该账号一致
fields.name: member_uid

fields.help_en: The page number of the asset list. Pages start from 1. If omitted or set to 0 during pagination, the first page is returned. If both Page and PageSize are omitted, all pages are matched. If either field is specified, assets are paginated first, and then ENIs are matched from the assets on that page
fields.help_zh: 资产列表的页码，从 1 开始。分页时省略或传入 `0`，取第 1 页。 `Page` 和 `PageSize` 均省略时，匹配所有页面。传入任一字段时，先按资产分页，再从该页资产中匹配网卡
fields.name: page

fields.help_en: The number of assets per page. If omitted or set to 0 during pagination, the default value 10 is used. If the value is greater than 100, it is processed as 100. If both Page and PageSize are omitted, all pages are matched. If either field is specified, assets are paginated first, and then ENIs are matched from the assets on that page
fields.help_zh: 每页的资产数量。分页时省略或传入 `0`，默认 10。大于 100 时按 100 处理。 `Page` 和 `PageSize` 均省略时，匹配所有页面。传入任一字段时，先按资产分页，再从该页资产中匹配网卡
fields.name: page_size

fields.help_en: Filters assets by the private IP address of the elastic network interface controller (NIC)
fields.help_zh: 按弹性网卡的私网 IP 地址筛选
fields.name: private_ip_address

fields.help_en: The ID of the region where the target VPC is located. If omitted, the region where the target VPC is located is used. If specified, it must be the same as the region
fields.help_zh: 目标 VPC 所在地域的 ID。省略时使用目标 VPC 所在地域。传入时须与该地域一致
fields.name: region_no

fields.help_en: The list of asset capture statuses. An asset matches if its status matches any value in the list. Valid values: 0 (not captured), 1 (partially captured), and 2 (fully captured)
fields.help_zh: 资产采集状态列表。任一状态匹配即可。取值为 `0`（未采集）、`1`（部分采集）或 `2`（全部采集）
fields.name: traction_status

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the target VPC. If omitted, the top-level VpcInstanceId is used. If specified, it must be the same as the top-level value
fields.help_zh: 目标 VPC 的实例 ID。省略时使用顶层 `VpcInstanceId`。传入时须与顶层值一致
fields.name: vpc_instance_id

fields.help_en: The list of vSwitch IDs to which the assets belong. An asset matches this condition if it belongs to any vSwitch in the list
fields.help_zh: 资产所属的交换机 ID 列表。资产属于列表中任一交换机即可命中此条件
fields.name: vsw_instance_id_list

parameters.help_en: Creates an asynchronous traffic diversion task for elastic network interface controller (NIC) that meet the connection requirements in the target VPC based on conditions. When the task is executed, a conditional query is performed for network interface controller (NIC) based on the filter conditions. If `Page` and `PageSize` are omitted, all pages are matched. To select all connectable network interface controller (NIC) in the entire VPC, you can pass only the `VpcInstanceId` that is the same as the top-level `VpcInstanceId` in the object. This parameter is used for adding new connections. If `AddedEniInstanceIdList` or `RemovedEniInstanceIdList` is not empty, the operation is performed based on the explicit list and this parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 按条件为目标 VPC 内符合接入条件的弹性网卡创建一个异步引流任务。任务执行时按筛选条件查询网卡。省略 `Page` 和 `PageSize` 时匹配所有页面。要选择整个 VPC 的可接入网卡，可只在对象中传入与顶层相同的 `VpcInstanceId`。 本参数用于新增接入。`AddedEniInstanceIdList` 或 `RemovedEniInstanceIdList` 非空时，按显式列表操作并忽略本参数
parameters.name: asset_filter

PrivateTractionTaskId.description_en: The ID of the asynchronous task for private network traffic diversion
PrivateTractionTaskId.description_zh: 私网引流异步任务 ID
